AP — "Iran's president delivers wartime address at UN: We have been 'victims of terrorism'" — 23 Sep 2026
(Search snippet content — AP's own reporting language, captured via Firecrawl search; full article not fetched)

"In a defiant speech, President Masoud Pezeshkian held up large photos of the late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and the more than 150 school Iranian children killed on the first days of the war."
"We are not terrorists," Pezeshkian said at the General Assembly.
"Toward the end of his speech, Pezeshkian called out Trump by name."
Pezeshkian quoted: "Ladies and gentlemen, you all bore witness that this past June, my country was subjected to a savage aggression and flagrant contravention of the most elementary principles of international law."
